ov: كيف تحقّق ثروة طائلة (الإنجليزية: How to Make a Killing) هو فلم إثارة وكوميديا سوداء قادم، كتبه وأخرجه جون باتون فورد. الفلم مستوحًى بحرية من الفلم البريطاني الصادر سنة 1949 قلوب رحيمة وأكاليل، الذي كتب سيناريوه روبرت هامر وجون دايتون. يقوم غلين باول ببطولة الفلم، ويشارك أيضًا كمنتج منفّذ، ويشارك في أدوار مساندة كلٌّ من مارغريت كوالي وجيسيكا هنويك وبيل كامب وزاك وودز وتوفر غريس وإد هاريس. من المقرر أن يُطرح الفلم في الولايات المتحدة بواسطة إيه 24 في 20 فبراير 2026، وفي المملكة المتحدة في 13 مارس 2026 بواسطة ستوديو كنال.
plotEn:
On death row for murder, with only hours to go before his execution, Becket Redfellow speaks with a priest about how he ended up in prison.
Becket is raised by his single mother, Mary, who was disowned from the wealthy Redfellow family for choosing to keep her teenage pregnancy. He befriends the affluent Julia Steinway. Prior to her death, Mary stresses to a young Becket that he should fight for the life he "deserves" to have.
Years later, an adult Becket works as a salesman at a suit store in Manhattan, where he reconnects with Julia, who is about to get married. Due to a loophole in the will, he is still last in line for the $28 billion Redfellow family fortune. Taken aback, he learns that his position at the luxury store has been given to the owner's son, a school dropout, demoting Becket to a warehouse job in New Jersey. Becket decides to claim his inheritance by murdering the remaining Redfellows. Becket first kills his drunk cousin Taylor on an isolated boat by tying his ankle to an anchor, which pulls him into the ocean and drowns him. He meets Taylor's father, Warren, at the funeral, who takes a liking to his long-lost nephew and offers him Taylor's job at Warren's financial investment firm.
